meta.title: Support for NATO
meta.question: Do Poles support NATO and Poland's membership of it?
meta.measure: Average support for NATO and Poland's membership, from 0 (opposed) to 10 (strongly in favour)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on NATO and Poland's membership of it, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: If there were a referendum on NATO membership, would you vote for or against? (undecided and would not vote have no position)
items.notes: CEEB 6, 7, 8 (1995, 1996, 1997); the label check keeps V62 of earlier waves out.

items.wording: If there were a referendum on Poland joining NATO, would you vote for or against?
items.notes: CBOS 1996-01 and 1996-12. The 1996-01 follow-ups (filtered on voting for) are not used.

items.wording: Which is closer to your view: NATO membership is (will be) a guarantee of Poland's independence, or a new form of subordination to a foreign power?
items.notes: CBOS 1998-01, 1998-06, 1999-02, 2000-02, 2014-02. The battery's other pairs (peace vs entanglement, stability vs tension, position in the world) share the label and are kept out by the value-label check.

items.wording: Should troops of other NATO countries be stationed in Poland? (definitely should ... definitely should not)
items.notes: CBOS: microdata 1999-2017 (6 files found by label); reports 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024 (trend table in K_024_24).

items.wording: Do you personally support Poland's accession to / membership of NATO, or are you against it? (strongly support, rather support, indifferent, rather against, strongly against)
items.notes: CBOS 1999-03 to 2017-02 (12 surveys: 1999-2002 and 2014-2017). "Indifferent" is the midpoint.

items.wording: Is NATO good or bad for Poland?
Does NATO protect or restrict Poland's independence?
items.notes: PGSW 2001; the counterpart of CBOS's guarantee vs subordination question.

items.wording: Should Poland be a member of NATO? (should be a member, should not have joined, should leave)
Do you personally support Poland's membership of NATO? (support, indifferent, against)
Do you accept Poland's membership of NATO? (definitely yes ... definitely not)
Do you have a very favourable, somewhat favourable, somewhat unfavourable or very unfavourable opinion of NATO?
items.notes: Pew 2007, 2009 fall, 2010-2013, 2015-2017, 2019, 2022-2025 (14 surveys; not asked in Poland in 2014). 2025 by telephone.

items.wording: Do you personally support Poland's membership of NATO (the North Atlantic Pact), or are you against it? (four points, no midpoint)
Do you personally support Poland's accession to / membership of NATO, or are you against it? (strongly support, rather support, indifferent, rather against, strongly against)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: Should troops of other NATO countries be stationed in Poland? (definitely should ... definitely should not)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: Which is closer to your view: NATO membership is (will be) a guarantee of Poland's independence, or a new form of subordination to a foreign power?
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you have a very favourable, somewhat favourable, somewhat unfavourable or very unfavourable opinion of NATO?
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.
